title: Bitcoin Races Toward Its Neckline As Hyperliquid Holds Strong
speaker: Drew Dosk

macro_themes.view: Bitcoin and Ethereum were saved by the bottoms of long-term parallel channels and are rallying into major resistance.

calls.condition: Expects a fade at the 89,363 neckline and consolidation down toward 80,500; a later break above the neckline targets 100k and 105k resistance.
calls.reason: Rallying straight into the neckline of a multi-year head and shoulders whose 37k target never hit; prefers consolidation under the neckline before a healthier breakout.
calls.quote: once and if we get price above this neckline, then I think Bitcoin actually hits the gas... hitting resistance here at 105,000.

calls.condition: If ETH holds/consolidates above 2,400 it can attack ~3,000, then 3,600 (channel midline).
calls.reason: Recovered back into the parallel channel from June 2022; next major resistance is the Jan 26 weekly high 3,041.67 meeting an inclining trend line.
calls.quote: If it can do so, it can build momentum to attack the $3,000 level

calls.condition: Above all-time highs, next target is the channel top at 110.52; consecutive closes below 89.14 shift toward 78.17.
calls.reason: Strong momentum breakout holding the upper half of a rising parallel channel; 50% line at 89.14 is the key support.
calls.quote: the next target is going to be the top of this parallel channel at $110.52.

calls.reason: Broke below its upward parallel and formed a bear flag on top of prior pivot highs; expects 7-8 more days of chop, a move lower to the top of the older parallel, then a bounce.
calls.quote: that could lead to another move lower and catch support right here on the top of the parallel

notes: No date stated; listing Oct 6. BTC support '$8,524' in transcript is garbled, recorded as 85,240 (inferred). ZEC support level garbled ('$,047'), omitted. BTC short-term target = neckline 89,363; medium term he expects consolidation (mixed).
